fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: UTC time at which the event occurred in ISO 8601 format.
fields.justification: Required to correlate activity across sources and reconstruct an accurate incident timeline.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Name of the host that generated or is associated with the event.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to identify the affected system and correlate activity by endpoint.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Normalized source family such as windows, linux, firewall, suricata, or pcap.
fields.justification: Allows downstream logic to select source-specific detections and assess telemetry coverage.

source_mapping.network_json: event_type or constant based on input file

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Origin of the record such as evidence_pack or student_telemetry.
fields.justification: Preserves provenance so analysts can distinguish baseline evidence from simulated telemetry.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level event category such as authentication, process, network, file, audit, or alert.
fields.justification: Needed by detection rules and triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized event severity using informational, low, medium, high, or critical.
fields.justification: Provides a consistent basis for alert prioritization and triage queues across sources.

source_mapping.windows_json: event_id and provider severity mapping table
source_mapping.linux_text: program, audit_type, and message severity mapping table
source_mapping.network_csv: action and rule_id severity mapping table
source_mapping.network_json: alert.severity mapping table or default: informational

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Numeric identifier assigned to an event or detection by its source.
fields.justification: Supports precise detections for Windows event IDs and numeric network alert signatures.

fields.name: event_action
fields.description: Action represented or taken by the event such as logon, execute, allow, deny, create, or delete.
fields.justification: Helps analysts distinguish what occurred from the broader event category.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Result of the activity such as success, failure, allowed, blocked, or unknown.
fields.justification: Allows detections and triage to separate attempted activity from successful activity.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account associated with the event.
fields.justification: Enables account-based correlation, behavior analysis, and investigation of compromised identities.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name or executable path of the process associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports process execution detections and investigation of suspicious binaries.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Operating-system process identifier associated with the event.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to join related process, network, and audit activity on the same host.

fields.name: parent_process_id
fields.description: Process identifier of the parent that created the observed process.
fields.justification: Supports process-tree reconstruction and detection of suspicious parent-child relationships.

fields.name: command_line
fields.description: Full command line or script content associated with process execution.
fields.justification: Enables detection of malicious arguments, scripts, and living-off-the-land activity.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address associated with network activity.
fields.justification: Supports identification of initiating systems and correlation with threat indicators.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source transport-layer port associated with network activity.
fields.justification: Helps identify client sessions and correlate connections across network sources.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address associated with network activity.
fields.justification: Supports identification of targeted systems and investigation of lateral or outbound connections.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination transport-layer port associated with network activity.
fields.justification: Allows detections to identify services, prohibited protocols, and unusual destination ports.

fields.name: network_protocol
fields.description: Transport or application protocol associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports protocol-specific detections and identification of insecure or unexpected services.

fields.name: network_direction
fields.description: Normalized direction of network traffic such as inbound, outbound, lateral, or unknown.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to distinguish ingress, egress, and internal movement during triage.

source_mapping.windows_json: derived from host and source or destination addresses

fields.name: bytes_in
fields.description: Number of bytes received during the network event or flow.
fields.justification: Supports detection of unusual inbound transfers and traffic-volume analysis.

fields.name: bytes_out
fields.description: Number of bytes sent during the network event or flow.
fields.justification: Supports detection of exfiltration and unusual outbound transfer volumes.

fields.name: rule_id
fields.description: Identifier of the firewall, IDS, or detection rule that produced the event.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to trace an alert to its detection logic and measure rule performance.

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed_fields.key when used as an audit rule key

fields.name: rule_name
fields.description: Human-readable name or signature associated with a detection rule.
fields.justification: Gives analysts immediate context about why network or endpoint activity was flagged.

fields.name: audit_type
fields.description: Linux auditd record type such as SYSCALL, EXECVE, USER_AUTH, or AVC.
fields.justification: Allows audit-specific detections and filtering without parsing the raw audit message again.

fields.name: audit_group_id
fields.description: Identifier linking Linux auditd records generated by the same audited operation.
fields.justification: Supports reconstruction of multi-record audit activity without collapsing or losing individual records.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Original Windows event channel or equivalent logical log stream.
fields.justification: Preserves channel context needed to interpret reused event identifiers and source-specific behavior.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Vendor, subsystem, or application that produced the event.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to interpret source semantics and identify the responsible logging component.

source_mapping.network_json: constant: suricata or pcap_summary based on input file

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: Filesystem path referenced by the event.
fields.justification: Supports investigation of file creation, modification, execution, and access to sensitive locations.

fields.name: file_hash
fields.description: Cryptographic hash associated with a file referenced by the event.
fields.justification: Enables indicator matching and correlation of the same file across hosts and data sources.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.description: Stable asset identifier assigned by the MedDefense asset inventory.
fields.justification: Allows events to join reliably with asset context even when hostnames or addresses change.

source_mapping.windows_json: derived by hostname lookup in asset inventory
source_mapping.linux_text: derived by hostname or IP lookup in asset inventory
source_mapping.network_csv: derived by source or destination IP lookup in asset inventory
source_mapping.network_json: derived by host, source IP, or destination IP lookup in asset inventory

fields.name: asset_role
fields.description: Business or technical role of the associated asset.
fields.justification: Helps analysts understand whether activity affects a domain controller, clinical server, workstation, or test system.

fields.name: asset_criticality
fields.description: Business criticality of the associated asset such as low, medium, high, or critical.
fields.justification: Allows triage severity to account for the importance and impact of the affected system.

fields.name: src_zone
fields.description: Network zone containing the source IP address.
fields.justification: Supports segmentation detections and distinguishes external, clinical, server, management, and guest traffic.

source_mapping.windows_json: derived from src_ip and network zone inventory
source_mapping.linux_text: derived from src_ip and network zone inventory
source_mapping.network_csv: derived from src_ip and network zone inventory
source_mapping.network_json: derived from src_ip and network zone inventory

fields.name: dst_zone
fields.description: Network zone containing the destination IP address.
fields.justification: Supports detection and triage of prohibited cross-zone and lateral network activity.

source_mapping.windows_json: derived from dst_ip and network zone inventory
source_mapping.linux_text: derived from dst_ip and network zone inventory
source_mapping.network_csv: derived from dst_ip and network zone inventory
source_mapping.network_json: derived from dst_ip and network zone inventory

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List of normalized labels attached to the event for detection, hunting, or workflow purposes.
fields.justification: Allows downstream stages to add reusable context without changing the core schema.

source_mapping.linux_text: derived from program, audit type, and parsed fields
source_mapping.network_csv: derived from action and rule mapping
source_mapping.network_json: derived from event type, alert category, and signature

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original human-readable event message or serialized source record retained without semantic loss.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to verify normalized fields and recover source details that were not explicitly mapped.

source_mapping.network_json: serialized original JSON record or alert.signature when a message is available

fields.name: details
fields.description: Source-specific structured fields preserved after common fields have been normalized.
fields.justification: Prevents normalization from discarding evidence needed by future detections or investigations.
